codeReview.summary: Pass. Commit c78f05a is a behavior-preserving DDD restructure: it renames the remaining monitoring/lists/logs/displays route modules into domain folders, moves shared cross-cutting modules into server/shared/, updates all server consumers to the new canonical paths, and removes the legacy api/data/helpers/types folders. The reviewed diff keeps the Express mount paths intact in server/index.ts, consolidates store consumers onto server/shared/store.ts, and the handoff records successful server build, frontend build/lint, Convex tests, and Python tests. I did not find blocking or non-blocking code defects in the reviewed feature diff.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared architecture notes still do not make the new canonical shared-module locations explicit after this refactor. Future workers can still be steered toward deleted server/data and server/api paths instead of server/shared/ for the Convex HTTP client and cross-cutting helpers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md:21 describes shared/ only as "logger, errors, ProcessService, store, mutex, utils". Commit c78f05a also moved server/{data/convex.ts => shared/convexClient.ts}, server/{helpers => shared}/settings-schema.ts, server/{types/index.ts => shared/types.ts}, and server/{helpers => shared}/user-agents.ts. docs/server/guide.md:89-98 still references deleted server/api/*.ts and server/data/convex.ts paths.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker import-audit guidance would benefit from a Factory-specific note to prefer fixed-string Grep searches for literal import paths on Windows. This worker followed the intended procedure but lost time on avoidable regex escaping failures before switching tactics.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: refactor-worker/SKILL.md Step 2 recommends rg-based import searches such as rg "from.*<module>". The transcript skeleton for session 83ee63ca-0c93-4898-8b86-8588df23a6a2 shows repeated search failures like "regex parse error: from ['\"]\.\/store" and "from ['\\\"]\.\/store\.js['\\\"]" while auditing moved imports.

summary: Reviewed server-ddd-remaining-domains via features.json, the worker handoff, transcript skeleton, refactor-worker skill, and git show for commit c78f05a. The feature passes code review: domain moves and shared-module relocations preserve route mounts, middleware placement, and store singleton usage, with validator evidence recorded in the handoff. I also noted one shared-state knowledge gap about documenting the new canonical shared paths and one skill gap around Windows-safe import-path search guidance.
